maddeler.e:
ارتقبنا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَبْنَا (irtaqabnā) /ir.ta.qab.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اُرْتُقِبْنَا (urtuqibnā) /ur.tu.qib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
